contract: A game project binds one exact immutable canonical artifact version for each sprite, artwork, music and GLB model role, plus an installed enabled managed app and a promoted or adopted experience.11 foundation fingerprint. Compilation re-reads and validates every byte, hashes a deterministic manifest, reuses an intact unchanged export, and emits a self-contained runnable HTML canvas/audio game. Publication atomically copies that exact export into the bound managed app data directory and records a read-back hash-verified receipt; configured records, missing bytes and unverified destinations are never reported as compiled or published.

dependencies.experience.11: ce639322 qualified durable promoted/adopted foundation fingerprint and withdrawal lifecycle
dependencies.artifacts: NativeArtifactProvider exact-version image, audio, model and HTML storage contracts
dependencies.managed_apps: Canonical installed/enabled app identity and isolated app_data_dir consumer destination

acceptance: Install a real managed game app, promote a real foundation, and bind valid PNG sprite/artwork, PCM WAV music and embedded GLB model artifact versions
Compile a self-contained HTML game that consumes its deterministic manifest in a canvas render loop, audio control and model download, then recompile unchanged inputs without creating a version
Create a new immutable sprite artifact version, rebind it and observe a distinct compile version while the prior exact bytes remain readable
Corrupt or remove exact input/export bytes and observe compilation/publication refusal without a success receipt
Publish to the managed app data directory and verify the destination bytes and recorded SHA-256 match the compiled export
shared_hooks: Root dashboard handler may register register_game_assets(app, app[STORE]) from game_assets_http
Root Console experience page may mount GameAssets
Root native provider registry may expose game_assets_provider.create_provider
remaining_limits: The export is a bounded standalone two-dimensional canvas game with an attached downloadable GLB; it does not claim a general gameplay or three-dimensional engine
Public URL serving remains the managed app's responsibility; this slice verifies the exact consumer file inside canonical isolated app storage
